summary: Iter 118 — Alerte surcoût e-invoicing (backend+frontend) + purge élargie (backend re-confirm). Backend pytest: 9/9 PASSED covering (a) POST /einvoicing/settings threshold=5 persisted, (b) POST /einvoicing/inbox/einv_demo1/reconcile with expected_ht=1000 → gap_flag='over', gap_pct=24.05, alert={overspend:true,threshold_pct:5}, (c) einvoice_overspend notification created (verified via /api/quotes/notifications/me), (d) same reconcile with expected_ht=1230 → gap_flag='ok' + alert=null, (e) /unreconcile returns ok, (f) DELETE /admin/users/{id} on disposable particulier purges rows (returns purged dict + purged_total, user removed), (g) 404 on non-existent user, (h) 403 self-delete guard. Frontend UI on /factures-electroniques (pro@construpilot.fr): PASS #1 threshold control (einv-threshold-input=5 + einv-threshold-save) shows sonner toast 'Seuil d'alerte surcoût réglé à 5%'. PASS #2 after overspend reconcile (expected 1000), einv-recon-einv_demo1 block renders '+241 € (+24.1%) SURCOÛT' with amber border; alert API returns overspend=true. PASS #3 after conformant reconcile (expected 1230), same block shows '+11 € (+0.9%) CONFORME' with emerald border, alert=null. Warning-toast branch confirmed in code (EInvoicing.jsx submitReconcile: toast.warning when data.alert.overspend). Note: reconcile from UI dialog via shadcn Select flaked due to CRA dev error overlay (benign ResizeObserver loop event triggers overlay) — reconciliation API path and reconciliation-block UI both verified independently. Pro Welcome receipt (task 1) not e2e-testable without real Stripe payment (as noted in request).

issues: CRA/webpack dev error overlay is triggered by benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' events, blocking user clicks during automated flows (and could confuse real users in preview). Consider adding a global window error handler in index.js to swallow ResizeObserver loop errors in dev, or disable the CRA overlay for warnings.
React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — add key on notif rows.
Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby (a11y warning).

action_items: (Optional) Silence CRA dev overlay for ResizeObserver loop warnings — add key prop in NotificationsBell map — add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to reconcile/decision dialogs for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/einvoicing.py _maybe_overspend_alert: correctly gates on gap_flag=='over' AND gap_pct>=threshold. Threshold default 5 read from einvoice_accounts. Email send is wrapped in try/except — good.
routes/einvoicing.py update_settings: clamps threshold to [0,100] — good. Upsert on einvoice_accounts preserves other fields.

routes/admin.py delete_user: excellent — purges via $or over 8 owner keys (user_id, owner_user_id, created_by, pro_user_id, owner_id, author_id, from_user_id, assigned_to) across ~50 collections, plus organizations by owner_user_id/owner_id/user_id and member removal. Idempotent per-collection try/except.
frontend EInvoicing.jsx submitReconcile: correctly calls toast.warning when data?.alert?.overspend; falls back to toast.success. Reload of inbox after. LGTM.

Notifications endpoint is under /api/quotes/notifications/me — unusual location (registered on quote_router). Consider a top-level /api/notifications alias for discoverability; tests and clients must know the odd path.
seed_data_creation: Disposable particulier TEST_purge_*@construpilot.fr registered then deleted via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. einv_demo1 invoice reconciled + unreconciled several times (final state: unreconciled).
